subject.en: Winking faceted buffalo with a plain muzzle and one rainbow flower sprig
subject.zh: 自然探头的切面水牛，眨眼表情与一枝彩色花叶

description.en: The face and flower sprig share a close portrait. A short natural neck enters through the lower frame, with room around the horns, ears, and the complete colorful gesture.
description.zh: 脸部与花枝组成紧凑的特写，短而自然的颈部从下方入画。牛角、耳朵和完整的彩色花枝四周留出空间，保留探头时的轻松神态。

description.en: Broad walnut and gold facets shape the head, curved horns, and relaxed shoulders. A plain muzzle keeps attention on the wink and the single mouth-held rainbow sprig.
description.zh: 胡桃棕与金色的大切面构成脸部、弯角和自然的肩线。鼻部保持干净，多彩装饰集中在嘴边的一枝花叶上。

description.en: Broken angular arches sit quietly in the warm mineral field. Fine grain and soft contact shadows give the flat facets a tactile setting.
description.zh: 断开的折线拱纹安静地铺在暖矿色底面上，细腻颗粒与柔和接触阴影，为平面的碎片带来触手可及的质感。

sizeNote.en: At 32 px, the broad golden horns, brown face, and colorful sprig carry the identity. At 16 px, the wink and separate petals simplify into the silhouette and a small rainbow accent.
sizeNote.zh: 在 32 px 下，宽阔的金色牛角、棕色脸部与彩色花枝承担辨识度。缩到 16 px 时，眨眼和独立花瓣会合并为轮廓与一小片彩色点缀。
